text:
anna: Kicking off blue->green cutover to service v2.1.0 in eu-west1. Planned ramp: 10% -> 100% over 20m. Quiet window 01:00-02:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: starting router config push (cfg-id: cfg-2987). will apply weighted-routes in 3 steps.

deploy-bot: traffic shift 1/4: 10% -> 25% completed. healthy checks passing.

sophie: watching error rate, latency, and 5xxs. if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 350ms during step hold and ping me.

raj: re: fallback, pin v2.0.9 in routing table for 15% reserved capacity. we can route new requests to pinned if v2.1 degrades.

mike: reminder: drain timeout on old pool is 120s, session stickiness TTL is 60s. might need to increase TTL to 180s if we see session loss.

anna: ack. raj, can you add pin? command you want me to run?

raj: I added a soft-pin via routing policy. command we used:
```
redwoodctl route update --pool old-pool --pin v2.0.9 --reserve 15%
```

deploy-bot: traffic shift 2/4: 25% -> 50% completed. metrics snapshot: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.12%.

sophie: looks good so far. starting synthetic user-scenarios now (chat regen + embedding load). will report back at +5m.

mike: starting gradual drain on old-pool nodes: `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --grace-period=180`. watch for conn reset on websocket clients.

sophie: synthetic load: p95 spiked to 420ms on one routing shard, investigating. Heading to step hold at 50% until we get root cause.

anna: pausing shift. taking 50% steady. switching to manual checks. raj, roadmap for quick rollback if needed?

raj: rollback plan: revert routing cfg to prior weight, restore session TTL to 60s, and unpin v2.0.9 -> full traffic to old pool. We keep canary logs for forensics.

deploy-bot: shift paused at 50% per request from anna. change window note updated.

mike: found cause: a kernel param on g4 instances causing slow memcpy under large-batch tokenization. applying hotfix to runtime nodes in green pool (no full rollback yet).

sophie: after hotfix p95 back to 220ms. 5xx rare. recommend resume shift but in smaller increments: 50% -> 70% -> 85% -> 100% with 3m holds.

anna: agree. resuming with smaller steps. comms: posting short note in #all-hands later and adding to release notes: v2.1.0: LB routing changes, session TTL tweak, kernel hotfix for tokenizer memcpy.

raj: my policy note: keep v2.0.9 pinned at 10% for 30m post-cutover as safety net. removing after we hit stable for rolling window.

deploy-bot: traffic shift resumed: 50% -> 70% completed. no critical errors.

sophie: monitoring green. will run another synthetic pass at 70% then sign off.

anna: thanks all. if anything degrades we trigger rollback immediately. otherwise finalizing release notes and scheduling postmortem for learnings. :thumbsup:
